title: World's Roundest Object!
summary: Veritasium explains the effort to redefine the kilogram, which was still defined by a physical artifact, and how a near-perfect silicon sphere from the Avogadro project helps. It also covers the history of the unit's odd naming.
why: Recommended in kilogram-redefinition threads as a clear, short explainer of the Avogadro and Planck approaches.
